title: Dispense-as-Written Provisions of the Pharmacy Benefit Plan Designs
content:
Three dispense-as-written (DAW) provisions are set for each Pharmacy Benefit Plan design. They concern a brand drug for which an A-rated generic is available.

- **Member brand penalty (DAW 2).** When the member requests the brand, the member pays the brand-generic cost difference in addition to the generic copay.
- **Prescriber waiver (DAW 1).** The brand-generic difference is waived when the prescriber marks the prescription dispense-as-written.
- **Counts toward out-of-pocket.** Whether the brand-generic difference counts toward the out-of-pocket maximum.

| Plan design | Member brand penalty applies | Prescriber DAW 1 waiver available | Brand-generic difference counts toward out-of-pocket |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Rx HSA Saver | Yes | No | No |
| Northbridge Rx Basic | Yes | No | No |
| Northbridge Rx Value | Yes | Yes | No |
| Northbridge Rx Select | Yes | Yes | No |
| Northbridge Rx Plus | No | Yes | No |
| Northbridge Rx Premier | No | Yes | No |

## Reading the provisions by design

| Plan design | Member asks for the brand, prescriber did not mark DAW 1 | Member asks for the brand, prescriber marked DAW 1 |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Rx HSA Saver | Brand-generic difference charged | Brand-generic difference charged (no waiver) |
| Northbridge Rx Basic | Brand-generic difference charged | Brand-generic difference charged (no waiver) |
| Northbridge Rx Value | Brand-generic difference charged | Waived |
| Northbridge Rx Select | Brand-generic difference charged | Waived |
| Northbridge Rx Plus | No brand penalty | No brand penalty |
| Northbridge Rx Premier | No brand penalty | No brand penalty |

On no design does a charged brand-generic difference count toward the out-of-pocket maximum. On Northbridge Rx Plus and Northbridge Rx Premier the waiver setting has nothing to waive, because no member brand penalty applies.
